title: Slice spec (.migration/slices/<slice>.yaml)
description: One vertical slice: its epic, where its flows start in each graph, and (for a per-slice source graph) what to extract. Unknown keys are errors, so a misspelt key can't be silently ignored.

epic.description: The slice epic's issue number (ADR-0022, ADR-0024).

data_paths.description: Anchors that must reach data through the directed flow (ADR-0020). TYPE=NAME matches exactly.

entry_points.description: Target entry points this slice owns that its data_paths don't reach (ADR-0026).

anchors.description: Undirected anchors reported by a per-slice graph run (findings only).

root.description: extract_slice.py: folder inside the source checkout.

bean_prefix.description: extract_slice.py: keep managed beans with this prefix.
